description: NaCdF₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.40 Å. Cd is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Cd-F bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.30 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Cd atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Cd₂ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Cd atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Cd atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Cd₂ tetrahedra.
